propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard model classes are approved but not yet enabled in rebar.toml because configuring fallbacks triggers whole-chain capability intersection that downgrades native structured output to prompted output

The Bedrock primary models support native structured output with and without thinking, while the current configuration keeps the corresponding direct Anthropic models marked fail-closed with PromptedOutput capability

Live direct Anthropic calls with valid credentials successfully executed native structured output and anthropic_thinking, proving the capability asymmetry is intentional fail-closed policy rather than actual provider limitation

The existing chain capability intersection mechanism conservatively disables features across all candidates before any attempt, making per-attempt capability resolution necessary to prevent silent downgrades when fallbacks are added
Direct Anthropic fallback is currently unreachable in non-interactive contexts due to a separate credential shadowing issue where an invalid environment key shadows the valid ~/.zshrc key
